name: 3d01-st-amount-optional
prompt:
In public/js/refine.js, every step in STEPS had an `amount` slider; the new `model3d` step has none (3D-01; the browser test test/e2e/model3d.e2e.js already exists, do not change tests). Make the amount optional, three SEARCH/REPLACE edits, change nothing else:
1. In pick(id), replace the four lines from `const a = s.amount, range = $('refine-amount');` to `showAmount();` with code that hides `$('refine-amount-group')` when the step has no amount (`hidden = !a`) and only when it has one sets the label, min/max/step and value and calls showAmount(), as today.
2. In showAmount(), return at once when `STEPS[step].amount` is missing.
3. In the submit code, replace `fd.append(s.amount.name, $('refine-amount').value);` with the same line guarded by `if (s.amount)`.
